notes.title: Join our Discord!
notes.content: [h1]Hey Dream Doctors 💊[/h1][p][/p][h2]We’ve just opened the official Discord server for [b]Doctor Dreams Simulator[/b]![/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3775270/Doctor_Dreams_Simulator"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]This is the best place if you want to:[/h3][h3]      - Share your feedback and bug reports from the demo[/h3][h3]      - Suggest new ideas for the game and discuss mechanics[/h3][h3]      - Chat directly with the developer and other community members[/h3][h3]      - Get exclusive sneak peeks, news and development updates[/h3][h3]Your voice can really help shape the game — every suggestion and comment matters![/h3][p][/p][h3] If you enjoyed the demo or just want to follow the project closely, this is the place to be.[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h3]👉 Join us here: [url="https://discord.gg/Zx4c7T2ymC"]Doctor Dreams Simulator Discord[/url]  [/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h3]👉 New Demo: [/h3][p][/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3900630/Doctor_Dreams_Simulator_Demo"][/dynamiclink][/h3][h3]👉 Trailer: [/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="_qMQ9jWEBc4;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][/h3][h3]For us, the community is the most important part of this journey — we want to build [i]Doctor Dreams Simulator[/i] together with you.[/h3]
